title: Aleno settings
description: Configuration for the Aleno terminal emulator. Save the file and Aleno applies it immediately; an invalid file is rejected as a whole and the previous valid configuration stays active.

family.description: Font family name. Must be installed; a monospaced family is recommended. Falls back to the system monospaced font if not found. Missing glyphs are drawn with automatic font fallback.

lineHeight.description: Line height as a multiple of the font's natural line height.

characterSpacing.description: Extra horizontal space per cell, in points (may be negative).

ligatures.description: Draw programming ligatures (=>, ->, !=, ...) when the font provides them (Fira Code, JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Code, ...). Fonts without ligatures are unaffected.

theme.description: Color scheme. "system" follows the macOS appearance live.

opacity.description: Background opacity (text stays opaque). 0 is fully clear.

blur.description: Blur the desktop behind the window when opacity is below 1 (macOS vibrancy).

blurStyle.description: Look of the backdrop behind a translucent window: "blur" (alias "vibrancy") is Aleno's own frosted blur, "glass" uses macOS Liquid Glass (macOS 26+; falls back to blur on older systems).

blurRadius.description: Strength of the blur behind a translucent window (0 = none, about 20 is subtle, 60+ is heavy). When unset, the standard macOS frosted material is used. Ignored with blurStyle "glass".

padding.description: Padding between the pane edge and the character grid, in points.

colors.description: Optional color overrides applied on top of the selected theme.

shell.description: "default" uses your login shell. Otherwise an absolute path or a program name found in the system bin directories. Executed directly, never through a shell. Applies to newly created panes only.

scrollback.description: Maximum number of history lines kept per pane.

cursorStyle.description: Cursor shape (programs may override it with DECSCUSR).

cursorBlink.description: Blink the cursor while the pane is focused.

optionAsMeta.description: Treat ⌥ as Meta (sends ESC-prefixed keys) instead of composing special characters.

notifyAfterSeconds.description: Send a notification when a command that ran at least this many seconds finishes in a pane that is not in front (needs shell integration). 0 disables.

confirmOnClose.description: Ask before closing a window. Quitting with open windows always asks.

keybindings.description: Shortcut overrides, e.g. "cmd+shift+d". Modifiers: cmd, shift, alt, ctrl. Keys: a single character or left, right, up, down, pageup, pagedown, home, end, tab, enter, space, escape. Use an empty string to unbind an action.

closePane.description: Closes the focused pane; closes the tab when it is the last pane.

reopenClosedTab.description: Brings back the most recently closed tab with its splits, folder and scrollback.

shortcut.description: Shortcut such as "cmd+shift+d"; empty string disables the binding.
